gloss.en: The root قيل (qyl) in form X, اِسْتَقاَلَ, means to desire or demand the rescinding of a sale or purchase. It also refers to requesting someone to overlook or forgive a mistake or fault.
gloss.short: The root قيل (qyl) in form X, اِسْتَقاَلَ, means to desire or demand the rescinding of a sale or purchase.
